notes.title: Patch 1.9: Let the Krolossium begin!
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2016-02-08/ae118339eb55d088cfd0afe9d3af93c7.jpg[/img]

The following changes have been added with patch 1.9.0:
 

[b]KROLOSSIUM[/b]
 
A new game mode has been added to the game: the Krolossium! It will replace Tournament mode from now on.

Krolossium’s rules are as follows:
 
[list][*]You can start a new Krolossium every 24 hours.
[*]When you begin a Krolossium, you will temporarily receive 20 random Krosmasters. Those are the only characters you will be able to use for the duration of the Krolossium. Krosmasters are selected through the entire existing cast: you will be able to play with them even if you don’t own them in your collection.
[*]You must compose a team with these Krosmasters. All the team building rules are still applicable. You will be able to modify your team between two games if you desire to.[/list]
 
[list][*]A full Krolossium will last 4 matches. You will be able to play it until the end even if you happen to lose a match.
[*]You will fight other Krolossium players. As opposed to the Tournaments, both players aren’t required to have won the same number of games to fight each other. Every Krolossium contestant is a potential opponent!
[*]If no opponents is available in a reasonable amount of time, you will be paired with a Ranked player instead.[/list]
 
At the end of your 4 matches, you will receive a reward proportional to your success. It will contain a random assortment of Kroz, fragments or even whole Krosmasters!
 

[b]TRAINING MODE[/b]
 
A new option is available in the Arena menu: it is now possible to train with your current team. Two modes are available:

[list][*]Train against a simple AI-controlled team.
[*]Train against inactive Krosmasters. They have been selected for their range of powers (Unfazed, Resistance, Krobust, etc.) to let you try your attacks against them.[/list]
 
All Krosmaster rules still apply during a training session.
 

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
 
[list][*]All Tournament’s achievements have been altered to now concern the Krolossium. This way, previously acquired achievements won’t be lost.
[*]Krolossium will fulfill all achievements that were previously linked to Tournaments, including daily objectives.[/list]
 

[b]OTHER[/b]
 
[list][*]Matchmaking: the system which paired players together has been tweaked. From now on, matches will be more balanced regarding the skill level of players.
[*]Stain: correction of bug linked to this power while Malee Buhrum is moving. Traps will now correctly affect her, and she will no longer remove a crate’s bonus.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.8: For a few Kroz more
notes.notes:
[img]http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/05/04/434854.jpg[/img]

The following changes have been added with patch 1.8.0:


[h1]New Krosmasters[/h1]
 

[b]Five new Krosmasters have been added to the list of playable characters:[/b]

[list][*]Grougaloragran – Old
[*]Grampy – Shopkeeper
[*]Joris – Master
[*]Le Chouque
[*]Darkli Moon[/list]

These Krosmasters can be found in standard and Season 3 Krosboxes, created by Recycling, or added through a real-life code on the Krosmaster website.


[h1]New additions[/h1]
 

[b]A daily objectives system has been added to the game![/b]

[list][*]Each day, 3 different objectives will be given to you randomly. These are split in three categories: general objectives, team building objectives, and Adventure mode objectives.
[*]Completing one of these objectives will give you a Kroz reward. You will only need to complete 1 out of the 3 objectives to get the prize!
[*]If the objectives don’t suit you, you can discard them and receive a new set of 3 in exchange (but only once per day).
[*]The current objective’s list and their progression can be found in the achievement menu.[/list]

[list][*]A menu showing your personal statistics is now available. You can access it by clicking on your Ranked Play icon, be it on the main menu or the Arena screen.
[*]It is now possible to select your graphics settings. To do so, go on the Options menu, on the “Display” tab.
[*]Ranked Play: players between rank 20 and 16 will no longer lose ranking points when they lose a game.[/list]
 

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
 

[list][*]Demonic Rewards: fixed a bug where the DR interface would not correctly display the cost of Rewards if a Krosmaster gained or lost the Crafter power during the turn.
[*]Fixed the incorrect display of DR when they are given to a Krosmaster.
[*]Deployment: when a Krosmaster is selected during this phase, it is now possible to cancel this selection by clicking elsewhere on the map.
[*]Adventure mode: fixed a bug which prevented the tension dice interface to properly display.
[*]Weekly roster: fixed a bug which prevented players to use a free Krosmaster more than once in a team if the player already owned the Krosmaster.
[*]Buck Anear: his Wave of Lies spell will now correctly interact with Phaeris and Lou.[/list]

notes.title: Last few hours for the Steam Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
The Steam Winter Sale is almost over... You have until 10 AM (PST) on January 4th to get your Krosmaster DLC packs at a discount! 

The four [b]Elemental packs[/b] and the [b]Elite pack[/b] are available at [u]-25%[/u], while the [b]Goultard[/b] and [b]Ogrest pack[/b] (which both contain an animated OAv as well as 2 Krosmasters) are at [b]-20%. 

New to the game of wanting to complete your collection? This is the occasion you've been waiting for!

notes.title: Krosmaster and Ankama Animation combines in two Steam packs!
notes.notes:
Krosmaster Arena unites Krosmoz's greatest characters in tactical arena fights. But if you want to discover their stories with your own eyes, we got you covered with those two exclusive Steam packs!


[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/420320/][img]	http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/ankama/www/12_2015/pack-goultard.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/420320/]Goultard pack[/url] will add two figures to your collection, [b]Goultard the Barbarian[/b] and [b]Katar[/b], two powerful level 6 Krosmasters in their own right. But you also get for free the [b]Goultard the Barbarian episode[/b], the very first animated project by Ankama, which tells the story of these two powerhouses!

[i]This episode is exclusive for Steam, you won't get it anywhere else outside of this pack! [/i]


[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/420322/][img]http://staticns.ankama.com/comm/news/ankama/www/12_2015/pack-ogrest.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/420322/]Ogrest Pack[/url] will add two figures to your collection, [b]Ogrest child[/b] and [b]Otomai[/b], two legendary Krosmasters with unique powers. But you will also get for free the [b]Ogrest OAV[/b], a 45 minutes origin story of the legendary ogre and his father, the greatest alchemist in the Krosmoz! 


Don 't wait any longer! Increase your knowledge of the Krosmoz as well as your Krosmaster collection with those two Steam DLC pack!
